title: Revision13 unified manager-intent/result/peer, child tools/full-byte review and typed-case SOURCE freeze
$comment: Contract only, not selected by any implementation consumer. SAME workspace-workflow-bridge-v1; frozen revision12 definitions and lifecycle V3 are referenced, not weakened. Endpoint selects one closed definition. No top-level permissive union, transport URL, execution authority, signer, dispatcher or allowance is introduced. Manager acceptance and coordinated F1/F3 adoption precede implementation. Exact current signatures/digests/UTF-8 bytes/safe integers/CAS/role/owner/root/holds/receipt joins are mandatory beyond schema; SOURCE specimens never reset live or exhausted ledgers.

implementationPin.$comment: Exact actual source+launch/leaf guard closure, not installed authority. Unique safe paths, whole file hashes/counts; no placeholder digests. Trusted registry must independently reconcile actual installed witness.

interpreterPin.$comment: Actual built Linux Sandbox interpreter+stdlib image witness; unavailable until registry adoption/readback, never macOS Python or caller pins.

scriptDefinition.$comment: FixedInstalledScriptPath is a trusted-registry-selected exact absolute path, not chosen by native/model/caller. Same fourth argv element must match installed implementation and independently verified source grant. No installed path is invented in this freeze.

childToolPermit.$comment: Protected independently approved actual-child permit BEFORE input/invocation, not a public endpoint/model argument or replacement V3 grant. Ordinal0 MCP, ordinal1 script consumes same child's settled MCP artifact. Source intent selection precedes actual binding; exact final permits are retained only after genuine preparation/assignment.

dataScopeManifest.$comment: Canonical server-derived digest preimage, sorted unique input ArtifactRefs, exact current selection/root and permit/consent path. Public observation contains ONLY dataScopeDigest, never a caller path.

childInvocationApproval.$comment: F1 protected server-retained association on existing case/control transport, NOT a new model/public/native wire or caller permission. All digests independently recomputed/currently resolved. Execution authority still requires unchanged actual V3 receipt, assignment, canonical grant and independent product policy; approval cannot dispatch anything by itself.

useSpecificSourceGrant.$comment: Exact protected source/installed-script/reviewer-candidate read association; no ambient foreign-workspace authority and NOT the child's own writeScope. Actual registered root dev/inode/no-follow verification remains required; rootGrantDigest is a reference, not root evidence.

childToolCaptureOperationRequest.$comment: Existing outer capture-operation request, exact domain observations including existing failure/unknown variants; no tool execution endpoint or observation dataScope path.

childToolCaptureJoin.$comment: Protected immutable facts added to existing operation snapshot, NOT fields appended to observation/payload/nativeReceipt. Typed root producer derives proof from actual protected child native DATA/process-output journal; parent signer/output protections unchanged.

reviewInputCompilation.$comment: Complete bytes compiled into exact existing V3 instructions BEFORE preparation. This is not reviewer consumption credit; actual reviewer-bound delivery/read receipts come later.

approvedWorkIntent.$comment: Operator-declared immutable exact work intent retained before its parent activity. No generated child Work/execution/service/attempt/fence identity is asserted here. Those bind only from actual preparation and STATE.

managerIntentPairRequest.$comment: ONE closed BODY with exactly two named members, not a model-selected action array. Each receipt/admission/CAS is separate. No member can supply prepare arguments, targets, grants or commands.

peerDispositionRequest.$comment: Explicit destination-manager decline only. F1-only retained output association, no remote/local child dispatch and no new domain signature.

intentHandle.$comment: Backend-issued reference, NOT bearer capability. Current node AND exact dedicated-manager lease plus accepted output/signed context must be reconstructed on every use/replay.

intentPreparationReference.$comment: Preparation response remains pending until the existing authenticated native receipt/report. Not an execution or fabricated readiness receipt.

childAdmissionAssociation.$comment: SEPARATE reservation/activation and canonical V3 grant after actual receipt AND assignment. No parent handle, output body or association receipt can mint this.

reviewByteSpan.$comment: Offsets/lengths address the FINAL immutable UTF-8 firstText, not raw-source offsets. Existing workflow instructions are canonical JSON; each whole UTF-8 source is represented losslessly by its canonical JSON string fragment (without quotes), never truncated/base64-only. Decode/reencode and compare complete original byte digest/count as well as exact final span. rootGrantDigest joins this actual reviewer's useSpecificSourceGrant.

reviewDeliveryPlan.$comment: Protected sidecar using actual reviewer binding/input and complete compiled byte spans; native/V3 grants remain unchanged. Read receipts are from THIS reviewer, not author/integrator compilation reads. assessmentPath is exact authorized own review_evidence output, never a script/library input path.

allocation.$comment: Frozen demand selector/scope, not an invented future Work/session/prepared receipt. Actual signed intent/input and prepared receipt are bound once through separate retained associations before that slot's effects.

controllerPolicy5.$comment: Prospective coordinated successor to policy4, not current consumer support. Actual applicability/identity/application are independently reconstructed; typed-case approval never supplies the installed witness.

controllerActivation3.$comment: Existing atomic signed activation publication, native admission shape unchanged. Prospective sidecar version3 binds typed ordinal/slot/context; no current installation/adoption.

productPolicyBinding.$comment: Separate independently signed product authority, never qualification-bootstrap purpose. Existing protected operator policy store retains this exact typed binding alongside full independently signed applicability/child policy and canonical receipt/grant evidence after coordinated adoption; this sidecar alone cannot permit a request.
